added_models.model: HBV-infected human liver-chimeric mice (PXB uPA/SCID with human hepatocytes)

engagement.model: HBV-infected human liver-chimeric mice (PXB uPA/SCID with human hepatocytes)
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; ACS Infect Dis full text paywalled. ARB-1740 is Arbutus's LNP successor to member ARB-1467, so product_in_model is false. Earlier chimeric-mouse use for ARB-1467 itself exists only in congress abstracts.
engagement.note: ARB-1740, the LNP sibling of ARB-1467, cut liver HBsAg in HBV-infected human-chimeric mice; no member had been compared on this system.
engagement.short: Sibling LNP siRNA cuts HBsAg in chimeric mice
engagement.quote: Combination of ARB-1740 with a capsid inhibitor and pegylated interferon-alpha led to greater liver HBsAg reduction which correlated with more robust induction of innate immune responses in a human chimeric mouse model of HBV.
engagement.judgement: Opens the human-liver-chimeric track at its first tier-1 use for the class; ARB-1740 is a platform sibling, not a member, so product_in_model is false.

engagement.model: HBV-infected human liver-chimeric mice (PXB uPA/SCID with human hepatocytes)
engagement.magnitude_basis: log10 serum HBsAg reduction: elebsiran increment ~1 log10 in PXB mice vs 1.03-1.65 log10 across doses (1.65 at 200 mg) in NCT03672188 patients
engagement.confidence_note: Full text read (open access). The chimeric arm had no elebsiran-only group: the ~1 log10 is the increment over muHBC34 (the murinized tobevibart). Experiment dates are not given; scored as a retrodiction because publication (2026-01-26, received 2025-07-24) postdates the patient data (registry results 2021-12-13; Gane 2023).
engagement.reason: Published after the clinic; direction and size reproduced

patient_trials.quote: The greatest mean reduction of HBsAg at Week 20 in participants receiving 200 mg was 1.65 log IU/ml.

engagement.note: Elebsiran added ~1 log10 HBsAg reduction in HBV-infected PXB mice, published after patients showed 1.65 log10 at 200 mg (Gane 2023).
engagement.short: Chimeric-mouse HBsAg drop reproduces patient decline
engagement.quote: muHBC34 monotherapy resulted in a substantial but transient decrease in serum HBsAg (1.46-log); the combination of elebsiran and muHBC34 showed an additional ~1-log reduction (total 2.51-log)
engagement.judgement: Noack 2026 appeared five years after NCT03672188 posted results, so it is a retrodiction (decision 10); the elebsiran increment sits within 2x of the patient reductions, but it was measured on top of an antibody, so the magnitude is medium confidence. Patient side named in patient_trials.

dose.model: HBV-infected human liver-chimeric mice (PXB uPA/SCID with human hepatocytes)
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; ACS Infect Dis full text paywalled. ARB-1740 is Arbutus's LNP successor to member ARB-1467, so product_in_model is false. Earlier chimeric-mouse use for ARB-1467 itself exists only in congress abstracts.
dose.note: LNP-dosed ARB-1740 in chimeric mice set no human exposure target; elebsiran 3 mg/kg once in PXB mice (Noack 2026) likewise stated none.
dose.short: No exposure target from chimeric mice
dose.quote: Combination of ARB-1740 with a capsid inhibitor and pegylated interferon-alpha led to greater liver HBsAg reduction which correlated with more robust induction of innate immune responses in a human chimeric mouse model of HBV.
dose.judgement: The 3 mg/kg mouse dose is numerically close to the 200 mg human dose (about 2.9 mg/kg), but no source states a target, so a drafter-made mapping is not scored (checker rule question, dose 2).

efficacy.model: HBV-infected human liver-chimeric mice (PXB uPA/SCID with human hepatocytes)
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; ACS Infect Dis full text paywalled. ARB-1740 is Arbutus's LNP successor to member ARB-1467, so product_in_model is false. Earlier chimeric-mouse use for ARB-1467 itself exists only in congress abstracts.
efficacy.note: Immunodeficient chimeric mice read liver and serum HBsAg only; they cannot express HBsAg seroclearance or NA-stopping criteria, the members' primary endpoints.
efficacy.quote: Combination of ARB-1740 with a capsid inhibitor and pegylated interferon-alpha led to greater liver HBsAg reduction which correlated with more robust induction of innate immune responses in a human chimeric mouse model of HBV.
efficacy.judgement: No member primary endpoint (REEF-1 NA-stopping criteria, REEF-2 and MARCH functional cure) has a read-out in an immunodeficient model, so the track stays untested here rather than contra.

safety.model: HBV-infected human liver-chimeric mice (PXB uPA/SCID with human hepatocytes)
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading; ACS Infect Dis full text paywalled. ARB-1740 is Arbutus's LNP successor to member ARB-1467, so product_in_model is false. Earlier chimeric-mouse use for ARB-1467 itself exists only in congress abstracts.
safety.note: Thi 2019 reports antiviral read-outs only for ARB-1740 in chimeric mice; no tolerability prediction was stated.
safety.short: No safety prediction from sibling study
safety.quote: Combination of ARB-1740 with a capsid inhibitor and pegylated interferon-alpha led to greater liver HBsAg reduction which correlated with more robust induction of innate immune responses in a human chimeric mouse model of HBV.
safety.judgement: Opener only; the abstract carries no tolerability statement for the chimeric mice.

safety.model: HBV-infected human liver-chimeric mice (PXB uPA/SCID with human hepatocytes)
safety.magnitude_basis: ALT: mouse ALT level vs volunteer incidence of post-treatment ALT elevation, VIR-2218 vs ALN-HBV
safety.confidence_note: Abstract-level; J Hepatol full text paywalled (scrape returned the paywall page). The abstract says 'humanized mice' without naming the strain or HBV-infection status; placed on the human-liver-chimeric track because a human-hepatocyte liver is what detects human-transcriptome seed off-targets. Comparator ALN-HBV is elebsiran's non-member parent.
safety.reason: Humanized-mouse ALT margin held in volunteers
safety.note: Humanized mice showed markedly lower ALT with VIR-2218 than ALN-HBV; healthy volunteers had ALT elevations on ALN-HBV (28%) and none on VIR-2218.
safety.short: Mouse ALT margin held in volunteers
safety.quote: In humanized mice, alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels were markedly lower following administration of VIR-2218 compared with ALN-HBV. In healthy volunteers, post-treatment ALT elevations occurred in 28% of participants receiving ALN-HBV compared with none in those receiving VIR-2218.
safety.judgement: The model stated a hepatic-safety prediction for a member (ESC+ elebsiran spares ALT where its parent did not) and the volunteer data agreed in direction; the species could show ALT, so the comparison is admissible and the source states it. Later patient ALT elevations are immune flares an immunodeficient model cannot show, so they are not a miss on this track.

engagement.confidence_note: Full text read (open access). model_kind is ex_vivo because the enum has no in-vitro value; the cells are commercial donor hepatocytes, not patient-derived.
engagement.note: Elebsiran lowered HBsAg (EC50 1.4 nM) and HBeAg in HBV-infected primary human hepatocytes by GalNAc uptake, with no cytotoxicity.
engagement.quote: Treatment with elebsiran, but not with the control siRNA, led to a concentration-dependent decrease of the two secreted viral markers HBsAg and HBeAg with EC50 values of 1.4 nM and 2.5 nM, respectively
engagement.judgement: Opens the PHH track at its first tier-1 use for a member; earlier PHH work on ARB-1740 or JNJ-3989 exists only in abstracts or unspecified 'cell models'.

engagement.magnitude_basis: serum HBsAg decline in patients vs in-vitro HBsAg EC50; no shared quantity
engagement.confidence_note: Experiment dates not given; scored as a retrodiction because publication (2026-01-26) postdates the patient data (registry results 2021-12-13; Gane 2023). Direction only: an in-vitro EC50 has no patient counterpart.

patient_trials.quote: The greatest mean reduction of HBsAg at Week 20 in participants receiving 200 mg was 1.65 log IU/ml.

engagement.note: PHH knockdown of HBsAg with elebsiran reproduces the dose-dependent HBsAg decline patients showed (1.65 log10 at 200 mg); direction only.
engagement.short: PHH HBsAg knockdown matches patients, direction
engagement.quote: Treatment with elebsiran, but not with the control siRNA, led to a concentration-dependent decrease of the two secreted viral markers HBsAg and HBeAg with EC50 values of 1.4 nM and 2.5 nM, respectively
engagement.judgement: Retrodiction (decision 10): the human-hepatocyte culture reproduces the direction of the patient HBsAg response for a member; patient side named in patient_trials.

considered_not_added: AAV-HBV C57BL/6 mice dosed with elebsiran itself (Noack 2026, 0.98 log10 HBsAg at 3 mg/kg): the draft already tracks HBV-genome mice as hbv-genome-mouse; the checker's retro lead there belongs to that existing track, not a new one
Chronically HBV-infected chimpanzees: already tracked as hbv-chimpanzee

In-silico cross-species K-PD framework for 30 GalNAc-siRNAs (Drug Des Devel Ther 2026, doi 10.2147/dddt.s638364): elebsiran and JNJ-73763989 appear in its compound table with mouse and human HBsAg data, but the text reports only pooled class trends; no HBV-specific mouse-to-human statement to quote

Population PK model of JNJ-73763989 (Clin Pharmacol Ther 2025, doi 10.1002/cpt.3690): fitted to seven clinical studies; its liver-exposure and 2:1 trigger-ratio simulations were never checked against a patient result, so it is descriptive, not a tested prediction

Model-based meta-analysis of siRNA HBsAg turnover in HBV mice (CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol 2024, doi 10.1002/psp4.13129): mouse data only; its dosing-interval simulations were not compared with patients

HBV/HDV-coinfected liver-chimeric mice with murinized tobevibart plus elebsiran (JHEP Rep 2025, doi 10.1016/j.jhepr.2025.101400) and the hepatitis D phase 2 (NEJM 2025): hepatitis D is a different disease and every arm carries the non-member antibody

ARB-1467's own preclinical models: no tier 1-3 source (AASLD/EASL abstracts only); its platform sibling ARB-1740 (Thi 2019) opens the chimeric-mouse track with product_in_model false. ARB-1467's tier-5 patient releases (2016-17) predate Thi 2019 and name a different compound on each side, so no pairing was made
HepG2-NTCP and HepAD38 hepatoma lines (Noack 2026, HBsAg EC50 66.5 pM): immortalised lines; the human-hepatocyte in-vitro arm is carried by the PHH track
PHH cytotoxicity ('no cytotoxicity was observed') as a safety prediction: too weak a read-out to pair with human ALT; not scored
Cynomolgus or other NHP toxicology for elebsiran or JNJ-3989: no public tier 1-3 source and no FDA review exists (no NDA/BLA)
Patient-derived organoids or cells, PDX, human challenge, human genetic models: nothing found for HBV siRNA in any search
